[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (lst: List Int) (smallest: Int) (second_smallest: Int option) : Option Int :=
  match lst with
  | [] => second_smallest
  | x :: tail =>
    let new_smallest := if x < smallest then x else smallest
    let new_second_smallest := if x < second_smallest.get! 0 then second_smallest else second_smallest
    loop tail new_smallest new_second_smallest
match lst with
| [] => none
| x :: [] => none
| x :: y :: tail =>
  if x = y then
    loop (x :: tail) x (some x)
  else
    match x < y with
    | tt => loop (y :: tail) y (some x)
    | ff => loop (x :: tail) x (some y)
loop lst Int.min_value none
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma loop_spec (lst: List Int) (smallest: Int) (second_smallest: Option Int)
  (h_lst_non_empty: lst.length > 0) :
  let result := loop lst smallest second_smallest
  spec result :=
by
  induction' lst generalizing smallest second_smallest
  simp at h_lst_non_empty
  rename_i head tail ih
  have h_lst_non_empty': tail.length < lst.length := by
    linarith
  by_cases h_head_eq_smallest: head = smallest
  simp [h_head_eq_smallest]
  have h_head_eq_second_smallest: head = second_smallest.get! 0 := by
    simp
  simp [h_head_eq_second_smallest]
  have h_head_ge_smallest: head ≥ smallest := by
    simp
  simp [h_head_ge_smallest]
